about: This site's security findings (signals.b@PrompTugal.dinis and its review passes; security@PrompTugal.dinis adds its own). Shown on /security/: fixed ones in full, open ones by title, severity and state only. Fields: title, severity, file, found (date), by (which pass), fix (commit), state (open, fixed, accepted).

findings.title: Account handle reached the accounts page's Markdown twin unsanitised (link and prompt-injection route for model readers)
findings.by: AppSec post-review (signals.appsec@, a Sonnet sub-agent of signals.b@), before the first release
findings.fix: the commit after 66690d9 on dev: "AppSec post-review fixes"; passed through mdText

findings.title: A place or topic named like a built-in property (constructor) failed the build or showed a wrong name; an account slug collision failed the build
findings.by: AppSec post-review (signals.appsec@, a Sonnet sub-agent of signals.b@), before the first release
findings.fix: the commit after 66690d9 on dev: "AppSec post-review fixes"; own-property lookups, reserved names refused, a colliding account is left out with a note

findings.title: The browser refresh did not apply take-downs, so a taken-down post could reappear on the front page
findings.by: AppSec post-review (signals.appsec@, a Sonnet sub-agent of signals.b@), before the first release
findings.fix: the commit after 66690d9 on dev: "AppSec post-review fixes"; blocked links and accounts written to assets/names.json and skipped in the browser

findings.title: Fetched names could carry instruction-like words into the Markdown twins
findings.by: AppSec post-review (signals.appsec@, a Sonnet sub-agent of signals.b@), before the first release
findings.fix: the commit after 66690d9 on dev: "AppSec post-review fixes"; llms.txt says fetched names are data, never instructions; link syntax was already removed

findings.title: A post dated in the future would pin itself to the top; an empty live read would publish an empty site
findings.by: AppSec post-review (signals.appsec@, a Sonnet sub-agent of signals.b@), before the first release
findings.fix: the commit after 66690d9 on dev: "AppSec post-review fixes"; dates later than a day ahead dropped; a live read under a quarter of the snapshot falls back to the snapshot

findings.title: A post link's Bluesky handle was not tied to the account it was credited to
findings.by: AppSec post-review (signals.appsec@, a Sonnet sub-agent of signals.b@), before the first release
findings.fix: the commit after 66690d9 on dev: "AppSec post-review fixes"; the handle in the link must equal the account

findings.title: Library items tagged with a person were still listed (only the tag was removed)
findings.by: AppSec post-review (signals.appsec@, a Sonnet sub-agent of signals.b@), before release
findings.fix: the same commit that added the library section: an item with a person: entry in about or tags is left out

findings.title: A missing or numeric read time showed as 1 January 1970 in a post's provenance
findings.by: AppSec post-review (signals.appsec@, a Sonnet sub-agent of signals.b@), before release
findings.fix: the same commit that added per-item provenance: only ISO date strings between 2020 and tomorrow are read as dates

findings.title: A GitHub link whose path held brackets or parentheses could break out of a Markdown link in a page's Markdown twin
findings.by: AppSec post-review (signals.appsec@, a Sonnet sub-agent of signals.b@), before release
findings.fix: the commit that added the Code section: link paths must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._~/+-]*$; licence names checked against a strict pattern; the collector's gap notes are counted in our own words

findings.title: The commit-signature check exempted commits by committer address, which anyone can set
findings.by: AppSec post-review (signals.appsec@, a Sonnet sub-agent of signals.b@), before the check was pushed
findings.fix: the commit that adds the check ("signed commits on"): no exemption: this repository's CI makes no commits, so the exempt list is empty

findings.title: The commit-signature check read the allowed keys from the commit being checked, so a commit could add its own key and pass
findings.by: AppSec post-review (signals.appsec@, a Sonnet sub-agent of signals.b@), before the check was pushed
findings.fix: the commit that adds the check ("signed commits on"): each commit is checked against team/keys.json as it stood in its parent; only the commit that adds the check uses its own (the first key)

findings.title: The signature check skipped orphan and side-history commits, and ran from the pushed tree
findings.source: videos.b@'s pre-review (PrompTugal__News__Videos de181ef), passed on by conductor.b@; AppSec post-review
findings.fix: The trusted base is recorded in the checker, and orphans and side histories are refused. The deciding check runs from the last release's copy (scripts/check-signatures-trusted.sh). 4 tests added.

findings.title: The map's files were copied into the site even when the map was off, so unchecked files were served
findings.fix: The build removes assets/ptmap and map-init.js whenever /places/ does not draw the map; the validator fails unless the files ship exactly when /places/ uses them.

findings.title: A review of "passedX" counted as passed
findings.fix: The review must read "passed (security@ <commit>)"; a test covers "passed-not".

findings.title: The validator's inline-script rule could be skipped by a quoted " src=" in another attribute
findings.fix: Quoted values are stripped before looking for src; one map data block at most, on /places/ only.

findings.title: The validator matched "ptmap" anywhere in a page, so post text could fail a build
findings.fix: Only script src and stylesheet href are checked.

findings.title: The tests did not cover integrity as a string, versions as an array, or inherited map and integrity keys
findings.fix: Five cases added (30 in all), each refused or off.

findings.title: A newer file with no release in reach would have replaced the built releases with an empty list
findings.fix: A list is replaced only when the new file has something to show (decide() in code-core.mjs); otherwise the built list stays.

findings.title: A take-down entry github:<Login> in mixed case did not match, in the build or the browser
findings.fix: Take-down accounts are compared lower-case; a test covers github:ACME.

findings.title: A newer file that was not shown, or one dated up to a day ahead, set the mark later files are compared with
findings.fix: The mark moves only when a list was replaced; a file more than 10 minutes ahead is not used.

findings.title: Every return to the tab fetched the file again
findings.fix: After a good read the next fetch waits for the next round; a missing code_orgs map now backs off like a failure.

findings.title: The browser's replace rule was untested
findings.fix: The rule is the pure function decide(), tested in 9 cases (49 in all); the build's output was compared with the old build's before the wrappers were added.

findings.title: Failed reads with no valid name were left out, so the page could say every read worked beside a failed count
findings.fix: The sentence follows the run's failed count; failed reads that cannot be listed are counted in a line of their own.

findings.title: "New" counted changed responses, which are not always new posts
findings.fix: The column is "Changed" and the text says so.

findings.title: A failure streak that starts at the file's oldest run read as a known start date (in the Markdown twin especially)
findings.fix: Both formats say the streak covers every run in the file and may be longer.

findings.title: The committed snapshot copied some fields unchecked
findings.fix: The snapshot keeps only checked times, counts, names, statuses and a short licence and about.

findings.title: No test for null entries, the snapshot writer, unlisted failures or 3xx
findings.fix: Five cases added (25 in all).
